mechanism.closure: every registered payload now lands via payloadio.write_text — tmp sibling + os.replace — so a reader sees the old payload or the new one, never a torn one; the flake class is impossible, not patched
mechanism.explanation: an exporter was rewriting proofindex.json concurrently with the suite; scan_stamped read the file mid-write, got JSONDecodeError, and — per its never-raises contract — skipped it; the self-exclusion membership assertion failed for that one scan and self-healed on the next run
mechanism.flake: wave 19: test_self_exclusion_is_declared_data failed once, while the tree held a stale geointproof, and never reproduced
mechanism.not_the_cause: the stale geointproof was the tree state at the time, correlation not cause — a stale payload still parses, so the coverage scan still sees it
